system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: `SessionStart` | Agent session begins | `gt prime --hook && gt mail check --inject`
system_prompt_style.note: Context injected per-session/compaction via hooks; underlying prompt is the agent CLI's.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Gas Town launches agents in tmux sessions and communicates via `send-keys`.
env_context_strategy.note: Underlying CLI agents (Claude Code etc.) explore repos; Gas Town injects role/mail context.

context_compaction.note: Compaction is the underlying runtime's; Gas Town re-primes context around it.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Send work instructions via keystroke injection
tool_call_format.note: Gas Town exposes `gt` CLI commands to agents; actual tool-call format belongs to each runtime.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: It does not import agent libraries, link against agent code, or require agents to import Gas Town code.
edit_primitive.note: Editing is done by the wrapped agent CLI, not by Gas Town.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: A preset tells Gas Town everything it needs to launch, detect, resume, and communicate with your agent. You register it by creating a JSON file

protocol_standardization.note: ACP (Agent Client Protocol) proxy package shipped.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The Deacon runs continuous patrol cycles across all rigs, checking agent health, dispatching Dogs for maintenance tasks
loop_primitives.note: Mayor plans and dispatches; watchdogs react to events; failed MRs re-dispatched.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Workflow templates that coordinate multi-step work. Formulas (TOML definitions) are instantiated as molecules with tracked steps.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Your primary AI coordinator. The Mayor is a Claude Code instance with full context about your workspace, projects, and agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Worker agents with persistent identity but ephemeral sessions. Spawned for tasks, sessions end on completion
delegation_mechanism.note: Mail/nudges also provide a message-bus-like channel.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: The problems view surfaces agents needing human intervention
human_in_loop.note: Human is a crew member reviewing work; `--human` convoy flag and intervention keys (nudge/handoff).

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Work state stored in Beads ledger

long_term_memory.note: Beads git-backed ledger + hooks worktrees (file_notes); .claude/skills/ SKILL.md files shipped.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Agents lose context on restart | Work persists in git-backed hooks
state_persistence.note: Presets carry resume_flag/resume_style for session resume.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If red: bisects to isolate the failing MR, merges the good ones
retry_policy.note: Failed MRs are isolated and either fixed inline or re-dispatched.

rollback.evidence_quote: **Rollback capability** - Revert to any previous state

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Convoys labeled `mountain` get autonomous stall detection and smart skip logic

cost_controls.evidence_quote: You can also assign agents per-role for cost optimization

timeouts.evidence_quote: Uses a 5-second ready delay instead of prompt detection.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Gas Town orchestrates agents through tmux and environment variables.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Each rig wraps a git repository and manages its associated agents.

network_policy.note: No egress restriction documented; network used for git/DoltHub federation.

permission_model.evidence_quote: | `PreToolUse` | Before tool execution | `gt tap guard pr-workflow` (guards PR creation) |
